row: Sports Massage Solutions is a Surrey based massage therapist offering sports massage to a variety of clients. Our main aim is to improve your overall health and well-being whether you are a competitive sports person or not. SMS is First Aid qualified and fully insured. Get in touch and see how we can help you.
